frozen_before: any candidate of the independent A-prime confirmation pilot is inspected

budget.basis: the design estimate for N=400 (2,700-5,700 candidates; acquisition network 2.7-5.3 h and clone storage 11-21 GB), with headroom; environment storage is budgeted separately in Phase 3

gates.minimum_scale: >= 100 candidates from >= 10 repositories, all previously unused, and no commit ID from the policy-A journal
gates.zero_incomplete_evidence_admissions: no admitted candidate has insufficient evidence
gates.zero_revalidation_failures: every record revalidates byte for byte from its sidecar
gates.zero_hash_inconsistencies: no hash mismatch or integrity failure, and every stored object re-verifies
gates.no_protected_data_access: the audit-hook evidence shows no protected path opened (event protected_data_access is false)
gates.zero_vendored_or_generated_admissions: no admitted target is flagged by the frozen vendored/generated detector
gates.maximum_repository_share: no repository above 40% of admitted targets
gates.yield_or_projection: Wilson 95% lower admission yield >= 7%, OR the conservative (Wilson-lower) supply projection over the frozen repository pool reaches N=400 within the budget
gates.n400_projection_respects_repository_rule: at the Wilson-lower rate the frozen pool projects >= 400 targets from >= 34 repositories with <= 12 per repository

note: the gate does not fail because the yield is HIGHER than the old 7-15% estimate
